lines.x: Jensen Huang resigned as president and CEO of Nvidia following internal disclosures and US government inquiries into illicit chip exports to China.
Bitcoin fell below $64,000, losing nearly 7% in a single day and around 13.8% to 15% over the week.
Elon Musk has proposed a merger between Tesla and SpaceX, creating a corporate entity covering electric vehicles, AI, satellite networks, and space launches.
Officials confirmed U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin plan to hold a trilateral meeting Thursday on the sidelines of the APEC summit.
